h1.en: Keep Diesel 50 Concrete Pump under “Sound Pressure Level (decibels)” without new ratings

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel 50 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump. The page prints 0.4 m³. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. Theoretical Output 30 m³/h. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140. Diesel Engine (Power) 6105 / 99 kW. Put /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump. The published row is: Model Diesel 50. Pumping Distance (H / V) 150 m / 450 m. Theoretical output is printed as 30 m³/h. Copy the cells that page prints: Model Diesel 50. It is not printed on the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump page. Use that figure with /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump. Write to /contact, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Name /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump in the subject line. The power cell on this page is diesel, printed as 6105 / 99 kW. Another page in this set is /blog/buy-diesel-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry. A related note in this set is /blog/buy-diesel-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry. For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm and Main Unit Weight 3300 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump. The section title “Sound Pressure (Pa)” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是柴油50型混凝土泵的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump。页面印的是 0.4 m³。料斗容积是 0.4 m³。理论输送量印的是 30 m³/h。柴油50型混凝土泵页面上没有印价格。这一页的动力格是柴油，印的是 6105 / 99 kW。主题里写上 /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump。与 /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump 一起使用这个数字。写信到 /contact、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm，以及整机重量 3300 kg。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油50型混凝土泵列在 /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump。本批另一篇是 /blog/buy-diesel-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry。本批相关说明见 /blog/buy-diesel-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry。已公布的一行是：型号 Diesel 50、柴油机功率 6105 / 99 kW、理论输送量 30 m³/h、最大出口压力 30 MPa、料斗容积 0.4 m³、输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 450 m、液压泵 Kawasaki 140、外形尺寸 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm、整机重量 3300 kg。抄该页已印的格子：型号 Diesel 50、柴油机功率 6105 / 99 kW、理论输送量 30 m³/h、最大出口压力 30 MPa、料斗容积 0.4 m³、输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 450 m、液压泵 Kawasaki 140、外形尺寸 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm、整机重量 3300 kg。节标题「声 压力 Pa」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

question.en: Does “Sound Pressure (Pa)” replace The page prints 0.4 m³?
question.zh: 「声 压力 Pa」会替换「页面印的是 0.4 m³。」吗？

answer.en: No. The page prints 0.4 m³ remains the printed wording for Diesel 50 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。页面印的是 0.4 m³。仍是柴油50型混凝土泵已印的说法。

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。
